summary.zh: 漏斗结局率为百分之五点八；平均跳出率百分之五十五点三，但近七日趋势恒为百分之一，口径矛盾。
summary.en: Ending conversion is 5.8%. Mean bounce is 55.3%, but the seven-day trend is flat at 1%, an unresolved metric conflict.

riskiestCohort.zh: 到达首页后未按下开始者：漏斗流失百分之四十一点五，且首页退出占百分之三十四。
riskiestCohort.en: Landing visitors who do not press Start: 41.5% funnel loss; the homepage accounts for 34% of exits.

actions.actionZh: 为首页首屏增加固定可见的开始按钮，并记录曝光与按下事件；以按下率达到百分之六十四为验收。
actions.actionEn: Add a persistently visible Start button above the fold and log impressions and presses; accept at a 64% press rate.
actions.rationaleZh: 首页到按下开始为百分之五十八点五；首页退出占百分之三十四。
actions.rationaleEn: Homepage-to-Start conversion is 58.5%; the homepage accounts for 34% of exits.
actions.riskZh: 按钮可能挤压首页主要内容，需检查移动端首屏。
actions.riskEn: The button may crowd primary content; verify the mobile first viewport.

actions.actionZh: 在世界入口增加直达游记与谱册的可见入口；以进入世界后打开率达到百分之五十为验收。
actions.actionEn: Add a visible direct entry to travel logs and scorebooks in the world; accept at a 50% open rate.
actions.rationaleZh: 进入世界后仅百分之四十三点五打开游记或谱册，流失一千三百四十八人。
actions.rationaleEn: Only 43.5% open a log or scorebook after entering the world; 1,348 sessions are lost.
actions.metric: 进入世界→打开游记或谱册转化率：43.5%→50%
actions.riskZh: 新增入口可能分散世界页面的核心操作。
actions.riskEn: The added entry may distract from the world page's primary action.

actions.actionZh: 排查谱册页误触并修复高频触发控件；以该页每周暴躁点击数低于一百七十为验收。
actions.actionEn: Audit accidental taps and fix frequently triggered controls on the scorebook page; accept below 170 weekly rage clicks.
actions.rationaleZh: 谱册页记录到二百一十三次暴躁点击；需核对统计周期与去重口径。
actions.rationaleEn: The scorebook page records 213 rage clicks; verify the reporting period and deduplication method.
actions.metric: 谱册页每周暴躁点击数：213→低于170
actions.riskZh: 点击事件口径不一致会造成错误归因。
actions.riskEn: Inconsistent click-event definitions could lead to false attribution.

actions.actionZh: 为正文加入阅读进度与下一篇入口；以读完率达到百分之七十为验收。
actions.actionEn: Add reading progress and a next-article entry to body pages; accept at a 70% completion rate.
actions.rationaleZh: 打开游记或谱册后读完率为百分之六十五点五，未读完三百五十八人。
actions.rationaleEn: After opening a log or scorebook, completion is 65.5%; 358 sessions do not finish.
actions.metric: 打开游记或谱册→读完正文转化率：65.5%→70%
actions.riskZh: 进度提示可能促使快速滚动而非有效阅读。
actions.riskEn: Progress indicators may encourage scrolling without meaningful reading.

sensitivity.zh: 首页跳出最敏感：均值百分之五十五点三，但近七日百分之一，矛盾须先核实。
sensitivity.en: Homepage bounce is the key sensitivity: 55.3% mean conflicts with a flat 1% seven-day trend; verify first.
